stemMarkdown: At what rate percent per annum of simple interest will a sum of money become 4 times itself in 16 years? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: To become 4 times itself, the interest earned must be $3$ times the principal. So $\dfrac{P \times R \times 16}{100} = 3P$, giving $R = \dfrac{3 \times 100}{16} = 18.75\%$.
